parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Describe how the release of dopamine from the presynaptic neurone can lead to an action potential in the postsynaptic neurone.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
In brain cells, the amino acid tyrosine is changed into DOPA, which then is converted to dopamine.

Name another compound in the body produced from DOPA.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
In some brain synapses, the neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) is released. This results in an influx of chloride ions into the postsynaptic neurone.

Suggest **and** explain whether an action potential would be generated in the postsynaptic neurone if GABA is released into a brain synapse.
